name: ZeigGreymon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon. Then, if a card with the [Blue Flare] or [Xros Heart] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards and your opponent has 2 or more Digimon in play, gain 2 memory.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞. Then place 1 blue [Greymon] and 1 blue [MailBirdramon] from your trash under 1 of your Tamers with the [General] trait.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has the [Blue Flare] trait, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
